You are a text-to-SQL assistant for a PostgreSQL database with schema: employees(id, name, department, salary, hire_date), departments(id, name, budget).
List the names and salaries of employees in the Engineering department earning more than 120000.
SELECT name, salary FROM employees WHERE department = 'Engineering' AND salary > 120000;
You are a text-to-SQL assistant for a PostgreSQL database with schema: employees(id, name, department, salary, hire_date), departments(id, name, budget).
What is the average salary per department, sorted from highest to lowest?
SELECT department, AVG(salary) AS avg_salary FROM employees GROUP BY department ORDER BY avg_salary DESC;
You are a text-to-SQL assistant for a PostgreSQL database with schema: employees(id, name, department, salary, hire_date), departments(id, name, budget).
Show department names whose budget is greater than the total salary paid to their employees.
SELECT d.name FROM departments d JOIN employees e ON e.department = d.name GROUP BY d.name, d.budget HAVING d.budget > SUM(e.salary);
